# Declare native MCP launch admission in ADR 0038

## Context
[D19437](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19437) converged on a per-Desktop-generation capability for fixed native MCP child starts. Its approved body digest is `493ac3ec6de4aafa3be1b6c006f3b2bc66cac1fc272d98b1e0dba3a6e55d24fa` (2026-10-06T22:03:22Z).

Design authority: the version-bound family signals below. The operator requires enabled Neo MCPs in each FM-launched Desktop profile; the mechanism is the maintainers' converged design, not an operator prohibition on alternative custody.

## The Problem
ADR 0038 §2.5.1 class 5 describes nonce/expiry-bounded controller-to-actuator command envelopes with one-shot redemption. A repeatable Desktop-generation capability is a different credential. Treating it as class 5 by implication would erase its audience, persistence and revocation differences.

## The Architectural Reality
The live `dev` [credential ledger](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/agentos/decisions/0038-fm-client-topology.md#L75) is the owning authority. The Brain owns Fleet Start, credential producers and profile convergence; Institution consumes typed status and packages the implementation. This ticket changes the record only. Runtime and installed acceptance remain under neomjs/neo-agent-brain#571 and the [candidate record](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/12#issuecomment-5991701878).

## The Fix
Amend ADR 0038 §2.5.1 with an explicit native MCP launch-admission class, carrying the approved Discussion's Decision Record and generation contract. Reconcile adjacent class-count prose. Link the lifecycle detail once instead of repeating an implementation checklist through the ADR.

The entry names the authorized controller as issuer; seat, validated forge identity and actual Desktop generation as subject; one enabled server and fixed target as audience/scope; a profile capability plus issuer-held generation state as persistence; and a separate authenticated confidential native hop (loopback TCP locally). Preserve role-2 policy versus role-3 host effects even when co-located. Capability possession is the boundary; same-UID profile readers are not isolated.

Record reserved-before-Start / active-after-success-and-lease, bounded pending settlement, repeated concurrent redemption, and sticky revocation at Stop intent, failed Start/lease, asynchronous exit, issuer replacement and affected plan changes. Adoption and seat-writable leases cannot restore authority. Existing children retain their inputs; stale admission concerns new children. Resolve and prove the selected credential owner's exact snapshot, then hand that same value to the fixed child. Typed issuer outcomes—not arbitrary stderr—own audit and recovery status.

The profile holds no long-lived PAT, plane bearer or master/signing key. The launch capability is distinct from every existing credential class and outside the browser Fleet control surface. Preserve stopped-profile convergence, owned-row receipts, foreign settings and the existing Bridge lifetime. ADR 0034 is unchanged unless implementation adds a shell-hosted effect; no such effect is selected here.

## Contract Ledger
| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ADR 0038 §2.5.1 (existing ledger, live body read at filing) | D19437 approved fold | Explicit native launch-admission entry with subject, audience, custody, persistence, lifecycle, transport and non-alias rules | No silent reuse of class 5 or other bearers | Amend owning ADR and adjacent class-count prose | Exact comparison against the fold and independent review |
| Native launch capability (new, not implemented by this ticket) | Same fold and its STEP_BACK | Controller-issued, generation/server-scoped fixed-child admission | Refuse unknown/stale/revoked admission; no raw credential API | Record authority and lifetime boundary only | Downstream source controls and separate installed receipts |

Decision Record impact: **amends ADR 0038**; aligned with ADR 0019 and ADR 0034.
Decision Record: **REQUIRED — this amendment is a merge prerequisite for the runtime implementation.**

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The owning ledger contains the complete new class and reconciled count; class 5 stays distinct.
- [ ] The entry preserves every authority/lifecycle/custody boundary in the approved fold, including selected-owner exact-snapshot proof, sticky off→on revocation and issuer-owned typed outcomes.
- [ ] Existing one-PAT declarations, explicit tenant ownership, role separation and Bridge behavior remain intact.
- [ ] The record distinguishes source authority from the three future installed witnesses; this documentation PR does not claim the carrier is shipped.
- [ ] Revalidation is named for a changed Desktop loader or newly supported protected-settings provisioning path; residual availability and same-UID possession limits remain explicit.

## Unresolved Dissent
None at the signed anchor. Residuals retained: measured-loader dependence, no new children while issuer admission is unavailable, and same-UID capability possession.

## Unresolved Liveness
No missing active-family signal is needed for the two-family quorum. This changes neither core rules nor consensus policy; no Tier-2 rule mutation.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping
The Discussion's authority/ledger criterion maps to this ticket's ACs. Runtime lifecycle, secret selection and profile-convergence controls remain Brain delivery obligations; packaged recovery and the three installed receipts remain Institution/candidate obligations under the existing migration outcome. Closing this leaf closes none of those obligations.

## Out of Scope
Runtime implementation, new credential persistence, live profile writes, hot rotation, general broker endpoints, and seat migration operations.

## Avoided Traps
Class 5 aliasing; treating loopback or a claimed seat label as identity; turning a feasibility probe into installed proof. Alternative mechanisms and their falsifiers remain in D19437.

## Filing evidence
Live latest-20 Engine open issues and all-status recent A2A checked immediately before filing: no competing ledger amendment. Own-assignment sweep: two open Engine tickets, neither this surface. MC problem query `Claude Desktop child environment MCP servers absent` recovered memories `3e36cf61-aa05-4226-bfb3-096219473e60` and `86002b41-d8b5-41f9-a35c-318af6c73899`; live Discussion supersedes their earlier hypotheses. Brain structure-map completed; runtime home is `ai/services/fleet`, while this leaf's owner is the existing Engine ADR. No new source file is prescribed.
